metric.name: Ordered Note F1 (MIDI-LCS)
metric.matching: longest common subsequence with one-to-one ordered matches

formats.hz: prediction within +/-1% of the ground-truth frequency
formats.doremi: pitch-class match; reported only, excluded from any_note_f1

metric.table_aggregation: max(midi_note_f1, spn_note_f1, hz_note_f1) per stimulus, then macro mean over stimuli

source: saved raw responses in paper/evaluation Category-F result JSON files
